lyrics.original: 날 보는 네 눈에 열린, Another world
lyrics.romanization: nal boneun ne nune yeollin, another world
lyrics.english: In your eyes as you look at me, Another world

lyrics.original: 덧날 뿐인 흉터들까지, You save my soul
lyrics.romanization: deotnal ppunin hyangteodeulkkaji, you save my soul
lyrics.english: Even the scars that only fester, You save my soul

lyrics.original: 첫 마주쳤던 Angel eyes, 또 애틋한 Your paradise
lyrics.romanization: cheot majuchyeotdeon angel eyes, tto aeteuthan your paradise
lyrics.english: The angel eyes I first looked into, And your achingly sweet paradise

lyrics.original: 그 안 눈을 떠 버린, 갈망들이 지독해
lyrics.romanization: geu an nuneul tteo beorin, galmangdeuri jidokhae
lyrics.english: Awakened deep within it, The longing is consuming me

lyrics.original: 네 눈빛 만으로, 난 이미 Can’t escape
lyrics.romanization: ne nunbit maneuro, nan imi can’t escape
lyrics.english: With just one look from you, I'm already trapped, can’t escape

lyrics.original: You’re supernatural, 내게
lyrics.romanization: you’re supernatural, naege
lyrics.english: You’re supernatural, To me

lyrics.original: Take me down, 더 깊이 새겨지게
lyrics.romanization: take me down, deo gipi saegyeojige
lyrics.english: Take me down, So you'll be carved deeper into me

lyrics.original: Tame me now, 너로 날 물들이게
lyrics.romanization: tame me now, neoro nal muldeurige
lyrics.english: Tame me now, So you can paint me in your colors

lyrics.original: 남겨줘 내 상처 위, 네 것이라는 표식
lyrics.romanization: namgyeojwo nae sangcheo wi, ne geosiraneun pyosik
lyrics.english: Leave upon my scars, A mark that says I'm yours

lyrics.original: Eye to eye, 영원히 너를 Mark on me
lyrics.romanization: eye to eye, yeongwonhi neoreul mark on me
lyrics.english: Eye to eye, Forever, leave your mark on me

lyrics.original: 널 보는 내 맘의 열긴, 식지 않고
lyrics.romanization: neol boneun nae mame yeolgin, sikji anko
lyrics.english: The fire in my heart when I see you, Never fades

lyrics.original: 널 새기는 고통은 나를, 살게 하고
lyrics.romanization: neol saegineun gopteun nareul, salge hago
lyrics.english: The pain of carving you into me, Keeps me alive

lyrics.original: 내 본능마저 잊게 한, 넌 나의 모든 Paradigm
lyrics.romanization: nae bonneungmajeo itge han, neon naui modeun paradigm
lyrics.english: You made me forget even my instincts, You're my entire paradigm

lyrics.original: 날 새롭게 길들인, 너의 눈빛, 손짓, Breath
lyrics.romanization: nal saeropge gildeurin, neoui nunbit, sonjit, breath
lyrics.english: Taming me all over again, Your gaze, touch, breath

lyrics.original: 네 숨결 하나로, 날 무너지게 해
lyrics.romanization: ne sumgyeol hanaro, nal muneojige hae
lyrics.english: With just one breath, You make me fall apart

lyrics.original: 그대로 이끌려, It’s fate
lyrics.romanization: geudaero ikkeullyeo, it’s fate
lyrics.english: I let myself be swept away, It’s fate

lyrics.original: Take me down, 어둠이 서린 밤에
lyrics.romanization: take me down, eodumi seorin bame
lyrics.english: Take me down, On a night steeped in darkness

lyrics.original: Tame me now, 둘만의 춤을 추게
lyrics.romanization: tame me now, dulmanui chumeul chuge
lyrics.english: Tame me now, Let the two of us dance alone

lyrics.original: 남겨줘 내 상처 위, 네 것이라는 표식
lyrics.romanization: namgyeojwo nae sangcheo wi, ne geosiraneun pyosik
lyrics.english: Leave upon my scars, A mark that says I'm yours

lyrics.original: Eye to eye, 영원히 너를 Mark on me
lyrics.romanization: eye to eye, yeongwonhi neoreul mark on me
lyrics.english: Eye to eye, Forever, leave your mark on me

lyrics.romanization: yeongwonhi neoreul mark on me
lyrics.english: Forever, leave your mark on me
